---
title: "Contribute"
description: "How to propose a workflow, a prompt or a failure."
---

Anyone can propose content. Every contribution is reviewed before it is published.

## Two ways to contribute

- **With Git:** fork the [repository](https://github.com/astronomicalintelligence/site), add a file in `workflows/`, `prompts/`, `skills/`, `agent-configs/`, `model-checks/`, `reviews/` or `failures/`, and open a pull request.
- **Without Git:** [open an issue](https://github.com/astronomicalintelligence/site/issues/new) and paste your text. We will turn it into a page.

## What a workflow needs

Start from this header and keep the sections in this order:

````markdown
---
title: "Short, task-based title"
description: "One sentence: what the workflow does."
categories: [literature]        # literature, proposals, code, analysis, writing, review
phase: "Literature"
model: "Model name and version"
tool: "Interface or tool"
tested: 2026-10-31
qflag: L1
time-saved: "3 h -> 40 min (measured)"
---

## Goal
## What you need
## Steps
## How to check the result
## Where it fails
````

## Review criteria

- The steps can be followed by a colleague in the same field.
- Prompts are given exactly as used.
- *How to check the result* is concrete, not "verify the output".
- Nothing confidential or under embargo is included.

A workflow enters at **L1** when the author has tested it on a real case. It moves to **L2** when someone else reproduces it.
